title: Prove concise setup context in installed sessions
text: Actual global receiving exposed project-registration guidance outside a project. Shared hook scope routing now excludes the machine state directory, but corrected installed proof is still owed. Genuine private-project import also blocked receiving despite authorized access. The receiving plan and existing installer campaign owner must prove the same corrected release for global, unrelated new/existing project and resumed second-machine scenarios. Preserve failed evidence and campaign ownership; source checks do not claim installed proof.
